Subject: Post-discovery: Demo scheduling - Fintech Solutions

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap from my side: 
- Primary use case: inference for customer support triage + dynamic routing.
- Key constraints: sub-200ms p95 latency for short responses, strict data residency requirements for EU customers (may be next phase).
- Stakeholders: Maya (ML), Carlos (CTO), per your intro.

Next step: 30-minute product intro/demo so we can show how Redwood handles low-latency serving, routing/fallbacks, and cost controls. Proposed times (all ET):
1) Tue, Mar 16 11:00-11:30 AM ET
2) Wed, Mar 17 2:00-2:30 PM ET
3) Thu, Mar 18 10:00-10:30 AM ET

Suggested attendees from our side: Vanessa (AE), Rafael (Solutions Engineer), Marissa (Customer Success). Suggested agenda (30m):
- 5m quick intro & success criteria
- 15m product demo (latency/cost controls, routing, quantization options)
- 8m Q&A / next steps

I attached a short demo agenda and a 2-minute pre-demo questionnaire that helps us tailor the demo. Can you confirm which slot works best and who from your team will join?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
Redwood Inference
